rule_description: Purchases of $1,000 or more require manager approval.
Software and AI service purchases require Security review.
Purchases above $20,000 require competitive bids or an approved exception.
Approvers may not authorize purchases above their approval limit.
The requester may not approve their own purchase.
Unapproved or high-risk vendors require Vendor Validation.
Every approved exception requires supporting documentation.
A purchase order must be created before payment is authorized.
High-risk international vendors require Legal review.
All high-risk technology vendors require Security review.
Travel requires Finance approval above $7,500 before July and $5,000 after the system update.
Urgent purchases require a documented exception rationale.
Equipment purchases above $30,000 require both Finance and Procurement review.
